subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary Confirmation
body: Dear [Name], We are excited to confirm your upcoming travel itinerary for your trip to Paris. Your flight is scheduled for [date] at [time] from [departure airport] to [arrival airport]. Please remember to check in online 24 hours prior to departure. Your hotel reservation at [hotel name] is also confirmed. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
